name: Muscles & repair

overlay.caption: tiny tears → repair crews → slightly stronger fibres

does: Shows soreness peaking a day or two after a hard effort, then fading
Shows repair work running in the background for about a week
Shows strength dipping first and then ending slightly higher than before
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Tell the difference between normal soreness and an injury
Say how anyone should train or what to eat
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Normal soreness is dull and fades in a few days. Sharp pain, swelling or pain that gets worse is a reason to stop and tell a coach or adult.

sources: NIH News in Health: exercise and muscle (student overview)
